what_it_does: Addresses complexity in programming distributed GPU systems for high-performance computing (HPC). Current HPC systems require developers to use separate programming models: MPI for multi-node communication, OpenMP for multi-core parallelism on each node, and device-specific code (CUDA for Nvidia, ROCm for AMD) for GPU offloading. This creates fragmented, hard-to-port code. DiOMP-Offloading unifies these into a single OpenMP-based programming model that works across multiple GPU devices and nodes automatically.
